Universidad Tecmilenio

Founded in 2002, Universidad Tecmilenio was created to meet the changing demands of the new millennium. Today, the transformation continues, as the Universidad Tecmilenio responds to world megatrends and the demands of the global work market. Their aim is to empower students to develop their own life purpose and to take charge of their own learning.

Tecmilenio is an educational institution with a unique model, a world first for our positive learning philosophy and methodology. They are known for the flexibility and empowerment that they give to their students, giving them the freedom to choose their own educational program, according to their self-defined life purpose.

Based on the science of positive psychology, their university model ensures their students’ ability to compete in the global market economy and promotes the well-being and happiness of the members of our community.

Currently, with 29 campuses located in 18 states of Mexico and Tecmilenio Online®, they offer:

  • 2 high school programs
  • 28 undergraduate careers
  • 8 executive careers
  • 7 master's degree programs

Their vision is: "To foster students’ discovery of their life’s purpose and the skills to fulfill it."

The Community is Composed of:

  • 81,000 graduates
  • More than 56,000 students
  • More than 4,600 teachers
  • 1,700 employees

Tecmilenio is based on the city of Monterrey in the north of Mexico.

Monterrey is the capital of the state of Nuevo Leon and it has 1.1 million inhabitants.
administrative:
1. Application dossier

You will work directly with the partner university regarding your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see the Americas Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be given to Epitech bachelor campus administration to reenroll for the PGE4 (in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.

This information is subject to change by the partner university. They will provide you with the most current information upon your acceptance.


2. Visa

In France: student Student Temporary Resident Visa (more information here)

Once you receive the acceptance letter from the partner university, you will be able to apply for a visa. Please refer to the Mexican Embassy or Consulate closer to you to ensure you have the proper documentation before arriving in Mexico.

General requirements:

  • Original passport that is valid for at least three months longer than your intended stay in Mexico. Photocopies of the main pages (personal data, expiration date, and photograph).
  • Visa application form, duly completed and bearing your signature. The application form is available at the website of the corresponding embassy or consulate.
  • Acceptance letter from UDEM. Sometimes you will be asked to submit a photocopy and sometimes they will keep the original document. Because of this, we suggest that you always keep a copy.
  • You must prove financial solvency and that you can provide yourself with at least USD$300 per month.
  • If the holders of the bank account that you will be using for proof of financial solvency are your parents, you must submit the banking certificate and a letter of promise from your parents in which they pledge to support you financially during the duration of your stay in Mexico. If you have a scholarship, you must submit a letter of proof that includes the amount of your scholarship.
  • Photographs (the format and number vary in each embassy and consulate).


Arrival in Mexico: Residence Card (more information here and here)

Your pre-approved visa is valid for entry into Mexico only 1 time and you must enter Mexico within 180 days of issuance. Once in Mexico you have 30 days to apply to your local National Migration Institute (INM) for the residence card that accredits their legal stay in the country and allows them to remain in Mexico.


Notes:

  • The process must be carried out in the city of your campus.
  • The INM closes at 1:00 p.m. We recommend that you arrive on time for your appointment.
  • Make the appointment as soon as you arrive to Mexico, because sometimes the waiting time may exceed the 30 days you have to make this process.
  • Write exactly the full names and surnames with which the person is being identified foreigner in the processing request. (Regardless of the number of names and surnames).


3. Insurance and Health

Incoming students will have to sign up for the Campus Accident Insurance Policy (price is around $544 pesos, approximately 30 Euros).

It is imperative that you take out an additional international insurance that will cover you for your medical and hospital expenses, repatriation and accompanied by civil liability. International insurance must cover the entire period of your studies in the country. Insurance costs are the responsibility of each student. 

To take out international insurance, the market is quite open. Please click here for more information. 

For more information, you can consult the country's health file at: https://www.pasteur.fr/fr/centre-medical/preparer-son-voyage/mexique

Note: It is advisable to register on the French register established outside of France and to report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs via the Ariane platform: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html


4. Prepare your arrival

Students will receive a guide from their host campus with information about the city, accommodation, important dates and facts they need to know prior to their arrival.

Students must arrive in time for their orientation to Tecmilenio, the time and location will be specified on the acceptance letter (this usually takes place a week before the beginning of the semester).

For advice to travelers issued by the Ministry of Europe and Foreign Affairs on Mexico, click here.
accomodation:
On-campus accommodation

Universidad Tecmilenio does not have residence halls.


Off-campus accommodation

Universidad Tecmilenio will provide information, contacts, and counsel in order to help students find a suitable place to stay for the duration of​ their studies.


You can also check out off-campus accommodation by yourself through websites like Vivanuncios.
courses:
Credits

Students must take a total of 48 local credits per semester to obtain 60 ECTS for the year, not counting EIP credits.

Most courses are 8 credits, so this means 6 courses per semester.

The grading system is based on 1 to 100.

In order to pass a class, you must receive at least 70.


Academic Calendar

  • Fall Semester: Mid-August to early December
  • Spring Semester: Late January to late May


Department and Courses

You will take courses in the Bachelor of Software Development Program and may also take courses from the Business Administration program. You will be attending classes at the Las Torres campus just outside of Monterrey.

Please note that most of the courses are in Spanish. The university recommends a minimum level of B1.

cost:
Financial Overview (4th Year EPITECH)

  • You must pay the tuition fees for the 4th year of EPITECH, as well as the re-registration fees and related fees.
  • EPITECH covers the application fees and part of the tuition fees.
  • The tuition supplement payable by you is indicated at the top of this page (if applicable).
  • Other costs at your expense include: travel, accommodation on site, insurance, and everyday expenses (books, food, transport, etc.).


Other Expenses

  • Roundtrip flights: about 1000€ depending on the airline & travel dates
  • Insurance: 300-600€ depending on the company and the coverage
  • Visa
  • Campus accident insurance policy: 30€


Estimated monthly budget

The local currency is the Mexican Peso. 1 € = 21.48MXN (rate as of October 2025).

Please check the Numbeo website to compare the cost of living between your city of origin and your city of exchange. Please note that everyone's budget will be different according to one's lifestyle.

The cost of living in Monterrey is between $600 and $800 USD per month considering: housing, food and other activities.

  • Housing: 100-300€
  • Utilities: 20-30€
  • Food : 100-200€
  • Transport : 20-30€
  • Local transport (one way ticket): 0.4 €
  • Monthly pass: 18 €
  • Taxi: 0.8 € / km
  • Phone and internet: 15-30€
  • Leisure: 50-100€
  • Cinema ticket: 4 €
  • Gym membership: 20 €

Prices are indicative and may vary.


Additional Information (specifics, advice, useful links, etc.)

  • Monterrey is hot! From May to August, temperatures can reach 40 degrees or more. It is highly recommended that you move into a flat with air conditioning.
